'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Joseph Graham DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joseph Graham]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joseph Graham]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
